reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. The deny branch in handleConsent (actions.ts:28-35) calls redirectWithError(redirectUri, ...) before the outer try-catch (L39-128), so a malformed redirect_uri supplied via raw form data causes new URL() to throw an unhandled TypeError yielding a 500. An attacker can trigger this via a direct POST to the handleConsent Server Action with action=deny and redirect_uri=not-a-url, causing an unhandled TypeError and a 500 error response. MEDIUM is retained: impact is limited to crashing a single OAuth consent request with no data exfiltration or privilege escalation.
